# Text art styles

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from the app's own style definitions. Do not edit by hand: change app/parts/01-data.js or the plugin, then run npm run build. -->

Every style turns the photo, or your lines, into letters. Pick one under **Style** in the Text art panel. Its settings appear below the style tiles; the rarer ones are under **More controls**.

All styles also share the settings in [Settings every style has](#settings-every-style-has) at the end of this page.

## Line text

Writes your text along the lines of the Vector layer. Letters grow and shrink with the width of each line.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text along the lines | Text, several lines | keep going · stay curious · be kind ·... |
| Print on | Dark paper with white letters, or light paper with black letters |  |
| Letter height | Slider, 0.3 to 1.6 | 0.85 |
| Letter size | Follow line width, Fixed | Follow line width |
| Fixed size | Slider, 4 to 60 | 14 |
| Typeface | Inter, Oswald, Playfair, JetBrains Mono, Special Elite, Naskh (Arabic, Urdu), Nastaliq (Urdu) | Oswald |

**More controls**

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Color | Ink, Photo, Duotone | Ink |
| Start the text again on every line | On or off | Off |
| Separator between repeats | One line of text |  ·  |

**Letters:** Weight, from thin to bold; Letter spacing; Italic; Capitals.

## Text portrait

## Settings every style has

These sit in the closed sections under each style. Click a section name to open it.

### Focus and fade

Makes the letters fade toward an oval, a circle, a band across the picture, or a column. With the section open, the shape shows on the picture: drag the dot to move it, the square handles to change its size, width and softness, and the round handle to turn it. Hold Shift while turning to snap to 15 degree steps.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fade shape | None, Oval, Circle, Band, Column | None |
| Strong part | Center, Outer area | Center |
| Fades | Density, Color, Both | Density |
| Size | Slider, 0.05 to 1.6 | 0.55 |
| Width of the oval | Slider, 0.2 to 3 | 1 |
| Softness | Slider, 0.02 to 1.2 | 0.45 |
| Turn | Slider, -90 to 90 | 0 |
| Center, across | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.5 |
| Center, down | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.5 |

### Opacity, effects and inks

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Letter opacity | Slider, 0.05 to 1 | 1 |
| See-through in light areas | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0 |
| Letter effect | None, Shadow, Outline, Riso offset | None |
| Offset ink | A color | #e4572e |
| Hand-set wobble | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0 |
| Limit to inks | Off, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 | Off |
| Color |  |  |

With **Limit to inks** on, the inks found in the picture appear as color chips. Click a chip to choose another color for that ink. **Use the found inks** puts them back.
